_readme: Release facts for /download (plan W16). The page reads every version string, filename
and size from here, so nothing about a release is hard-coded in a component.
sha256 is deliberately null. A digest is a promise about bytes, and the 0.1.0 assets
are not published yet — inventing a plausible-looking one is worse than admitting it,
because a reader who checks would find it wrong and stop checking. Fill it in when the
sizeBytes for macOS is measured from the local 0.1.0 build (release/ in the app repo),
not estimated. Re-measure with:  ls -l release/
Windows and Linux carry no size and no digest on purpose: the package scripts exist
(npm run package:win / package:linux) but the app's CI only packages macOS, and neither
target has been run on its own platform. Their card points at build-from-source rather
than a download that does not exist.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.note: macOS 13 or later. Requires one extra step to open — see below.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.note: The packaging script exists, but nothing is published for 0.1.0 and nobody has run the app on Windows. Bug reports welcome.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.note: Same caveat as Windows: it builds, in theory, and no one has tried.
